args.name: Safe assessment of alternative wild foods
args.function: Physically examine or test accessible wild food sources, including meadow roots, to establish whether they can safely nourish me and whether preparation is necessary. Report uncertainty rather than assuming edibility.
args.conditions: At tick 96 I have health 100, satiety 41.6, energy 16.05 and no inventory. Berries are known safe but repeated bounded searches found none. Meadow roots were observed previously; their nutrition, toxicity and preparation requirements are unknown to me. No root is currently within observed reach.
args.inputs: An actually accessible food source or a gathered sample; any tools or preparation materials genuinely required by the method. Exact method and prerequisites are unknown.
args.costs: Unknown; specify feasible time, energy, material costs and any risk before testing. Prefer non-ingestive assessment and do not consume unidentified food automatically.
args.effects: Obtain evidence-supported personal food-safety and preparation knowledge through actual examination or trials, if feasible. Do not create food, replenish plants, confer mastery, or claim certainty when the method cannot establish safety.

candidates.function: Inspect an established rooted food plant in reach and its growth needs, and loosen soil or clear competing plants by hand only where the growth model has crust, compaction or competition that limits it.
candidates.costs: Study: 3 rounds, no energy; needs probe. inspect: probe's observation of the plant, 1 round, 0.2 energy. prepare (hand loosening where modeled crust or compaction limits the plant, clearing where modeled competition does) would take 3 rounds at 2 energy each and maintain 1 round at 1 energy; this world's soil and plant model has neither condition, so both take 1 round, 0 energy, and change nothing. cancel: 1 round, 0 energy. Refusals cost nothing: target not in view or reach, or not an established rooted food plant that regrows (fungi, fish, seedlings, non-food and non-regrowing plants).
candidates.effects: target: a plant you see. inspect: probe's record (stock, growth, stage, soil) and the plant's growth contract from the existing rule: growth per ripe unit, growth so far, the least rounds to the next unit at the best rate (growth scale x full daylight), the temperature range (none at minGrowth, full at optimalGrowth), moisture need, waterlogging, harvest pressure 1/(1+depletion/20) and what limits it now. The first inspection records a baseline in your patch record (one square unit around the plant, at most 8 records); later ones report the change. prepare/maintain: 'no corrective work indicated', with the reason; quantity (rounds of work) stays unused. cancel: close the record for target, or all without one. Growth runs only through the existing rule, tended or not; harvest only with gather. No water is carried. Nothing is moved, created, refunded or rewarded.

candidates.function: A two-person conversation session over ordinary tell: propose it to someone you see within 5, each of you joins, then speak with contribute, optionally answering a heard utterance of the other.
candidates.costs: propose, join, resume, contribute: tell's cost, 1 round, 0 energy, 0 material. pause, leave, cancel: no energy, no speech; they only use your action. Study: 1 round; needs tell.
candidates.effects: propose: participants [you, them], topic (max 80), rounds 1-20 until expiry; says an invitation with the session id; only someone who hears it can join. join (with session and topic, the proposer too) and resume say a short tell; contribute says text (max 240) as tell; optional respondsTo: a heard utterance id of theirs in it. Each needs them alive within 5; words count only if they heard them. Active once both joined and heard each other. An answer with new words to their earlier utterance records a reciprocal exchange. Another action (wait is silence), urgent risk or more than 5 apart pauses it; both must resume. leave, cancel, death or expiry ends it. Your record shows only your acts, what you heard and changes within 5 of you. Grants nothing; no reward.

candidates.costs: 2 energy per unit, finite current source stock.
candidates.effects: Transfers real source stock to inventory; requires the source interaction range. No processing or felling is implied.

response.text: {"queries":[],"result_json":"{\"reviews\":[{\"actor\":\"kai\",\"decision\":\"develop\",\"ability\":null,\"reason\":\"Develop evidence-based food suitability assessment, not a new observation or sampling primitive. The supplied searches found probe, eat, gather and tend-rooted-plants. probe already covers observation and press/wet/heat trials, and its code must be reused; gathering, ingestion and plant-growth inspection do not establish food safety. The missing function is relating actual evidence to bounded, personally applicable nutrition, toxicity and preparation conclusions while preserving uncertainty. No universal non-ingestive edibility test is justified. An accessible specimen is currently absent, so development and individual study may proceed but assessment cannot execute on remembered meadow roots. Implementation/review waiting does not advance the world.\",\"specification\":\"General operation: assess-food-suitability(target, mode, intendedConsumer, evidenceRefs, methodRef?). Applicable to any actor and accessible potential food, not one actor or root instance. Modes inspect and trial share one evidence record and evaluator. References must resolve to a currently visible target within its actual interaction range or an owned sample stack; remembered locations and resource names alone are insufficient. intendedConsumer defaults to the acting actor; assess another consumer only from legitimately available relevant facts, without revealing private state or assuming their participation. Dependencies: open.probe, revision foundation-open@1, equivalence open-baseline:probe:1; existing knowledge/evidence records; source and inventory conservation; and, for a trial, an implemented method whose physical prerequisites and measurement semantics are actually satisfied. Record code reuse explicitly in implementation. Before adding code, the current-conversation handoff must check complete existing handlers for an equivalent evaluator and reuse any equivalent implementation rather than duplicate it. Minimal executable implementation is inspect plus evidence qualification: perform probe(target, observe, intensity), then attach evidence-linked conclusions of supported, contradicted or unresolved separately for identity, nutritional usefulness, toxicity and preparation requirements. Visible morphology is not chemical analysis. Never expose hidden nutrition/toxicity fields or convert a resource label into identification. Previously learned berry nutrition 8 and toxicity 0 may be cited as prior knowledge only when identity and applicability are legitimately established; they do not transfer to roots. If evidence cannot establish safety, return 'safety unresolved; do not consume on this evidence.' Preparation is unresolved unless an applicable evidence-backed method exists. Trial mode delegates only to an executable probe press/wet/heat method with an actual diagnostic relationship to the question; otherwise refuse the trial with its missing prerequisite, not a fabricated test or a rejection of future development. Heat requires a real usable heat source and safe handling; wet requires actual usable liquid and a container/contact arrangement where necessary. Missing measurement or preparation mechanisms, if needed, remain in the current-conversation development handoff for the smallest feasible implementation; none is silently granted. No taste test, ingestion or feeding another actor is included. Costs: inspect is one simulation round and 0.2 energy through probe, with no material use. A supported physical trial is one round, 0.5 energy and 0.1 unit from a real owned sample, plus the explicitly quoted method-specific consumables, heat and risks. Do not execute an incompletely costed trial. Before commitment, report prerequisites, applicable risks and the actual debit; invalid or inaccessible targets cost no energy or material and produce no assessment result. No extra assessment surcharge or second round for interpretation. Natural hunger and other ongoing rules still execute on action/study rounds; use current vitals, not the older request snapshot. Gathering remains a separate gather action at its existing cost of 2 energy per unit and finite source stock; travel, pickup and any implemented preparation retain their existing rules. Inspection creates only an evidence record, not stock, food, tools, safety certification or mastery. Trial input is debited exactly once; the consumed 0.1 unit must be accounted for as measured residue, effluent or loss under the actual method and cannot also remain edible inventory. No implicit edible output, regrowth, nutrition or detoxification occurs. Each completed one-round interaction commits atomically with a unique event ID and work progress 1/1. Interruption or death before physical commitment cancels with progress 0/1 and no debit or finding; after commitment, costs and any real residues or hazards persist and only genuinely obtained observations survive. Cancel creates no success; resume after cancellation is a new validated interaction with normal costs. No refund of spent energy, time or used material; unspent resources remain where they were. Existing completed evidence persists with its provenance and applicability limits. No autonomous testing, ongoing maintenance or safety guarantee is created. Freshness changes, contamination and preparation effects follow only implemented processes and can invalidate prior conclusions; reassess when relevant conditions change. Established evidence eligibility, cost accounting and applicability checks must run in code, not repeated model adjudication. Other participants must communicate and act independently through their own interfaces. Never alter protected rewards, budget, goals or permissions.\",\"learning\":1,\"experienceReview\":\"One individual study round, with no study/request/registration/mastery reward. Assessment itself grants no automatic pleasure, satisfaction, physical comfort or nutrition. A completed, verified new observation or informative failed trial may be eligible for the existing experience system only when it genuinely reduces uncertainty for this actor and is applicable to their circumstances. Deduplicate by functional finding, specimen class, method and relevant conditions rather than action name. Mere unresolved reports without new evidence and repeated identical queries earn nothing. Do not invent reward balances or a new scoring schedule: absent an established applicable bounded event rule with a cap, decay and cooldown, this implementation emits evidence events but awards zero experience benefit. Ordinary familiar legitimate practice may qualify under existing rules without a novelty requirement. Comfort remains capped at 10; hunger and basic nutrition are never reduced by mood.\",\"visualReview\":\"Emit reusable, event-linked metadata containing action type, target reference, mode, method reference, actual progress, evidence references, and outcome status: blocked, interrupted, observed, informative-failure or unresolved. Show inspection only during a real interaction; show heat, liquid use or sample change only when those events occurred. Findings display their provenance and uncertainty separately from animation completion. A completed observation is not successful edibility verification: unresolved safety must remain visibly unresolved, and failed/incomplete actions cannot show a safe-food badge, prepared food, full progress or a success effect. Reuse probe's existing interaction visuals where applicable, recording that reuse. No visual locates unobserved roots or reveals hidden stock or properties.\"}]}"}
